info.title: mrwho-cli
info.description: CLI tool for managing MrWhoOidc OIDC server with MCP (Model Context Protocol) support for LLM integration

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: mrwho-cli - Configure and operate your MrWhoOidc IdP

options.name: --profile
options.description: Configuration profile to use (recommended: one per environment)

options.name: --server
options.description: Server URL override for this invocation (takes precedence over profile)

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format for results (table, json, yaml) [default: Table]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview write operations without applying changes (where supported) [default: False]

commands.name: login
commands.description: Authenticate via device flow and create/update a profile

options.name: --server
options.description: OIDC server URL (e.g., https://auth.example.com or https://host/t/tenant)

options.name: --client-id
options.description: Client ID override. If omitted, the CLI client ID is discovered automatically.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Name for the profile (codename: alphanumeric + hyphens). Auto-generated from tenant slug if omitted.

commands.name: import
commands.description: Import IdP configuration manifests from files

commands.name: preview
commands.description: Preview a manifest import: show what will be created/updated and list conflicts — does NOT apply changes

options.name: --conflict-resolution
options.description: How to handle conflicts: skip, overwrite, or rename. Default: skip [default: skip]

options.name: --server
options.description: Server URL to import into (defaults to the current profile server)

options.name: --realm-id
options.description: Target realm ID (required when importing a client manifest into a specific realm)

options.name: --client-secret
options.description: Plaintext secret to supply for an obfuscated client or provider credential. Falls back to IMPORT_CLIENT_SECRET env var. WARNING: command-line secrets appear in shell history.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to the manifest JSON file to import

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply a manifest import, creating or updating entities as directed. Use preview first to inspect conflicts.

options.name: --conflict-resolution
options.description: How to handle conflicts: skip, overwrite, or rename. Default: skip [default: skip]

options.name: --server
options.description: Server URL to import into (defaults to the current profile server)

options.name: --realm-id
options.description: Target realm ID (required when importing a client manifest into a specific realm)

options.name: --client-secret
options.description: Plaintext secret to supply for an obfuscated client or provider credential. Falls back to IMPORT_CLIENT_SECRET env var. WARNING: command-line secrets appear in shell history.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Validate and report, but do NOT persist any changes (same as preview) [default: False]

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to the manifest JSON file to import
